 Balderson announces IRS tax relief for Ohioans impacted by severe storms and flooding 
 Open Audio Article Player 
 By The Herald Staff 
 on 
 October 21, 2026 
 According to US Representative Troy Balderson (OH 12 Congressional District), the IRS has announced Ohioans impacted by the severe storms and flooding that began August 10 can now take advantage of extended federal tax deadlines.The IRS has extended the deadline to February 1, 2027, for eligible individuals and businesses in Clermont, Franklin, Hamilton, Licking, Morgan, Muskingum, and Perry counties to […]
